n_b_input = input().split()
n = int(n_b_input[0])
b = int(n_b_input[1])
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
val = [1 if x % 2 != 0 else -1 for x in arr]

sum_val = 0
cost = []

for i in range(n - 1):
    sum_val += val[i]
    if sum_val == 0:
        diff = arr[i + 1] - arr[i]
        cost.append(abs(diff))

cost.sort()
tcost = 0
maxp = 0
for c in cost:
    if tcost + c <= b:
        tcost += c
        maxp += 1

print(maxp)
